remarks: Discover comfort and convenience in this well-located one-bedroom one-bathroom condo in Millwoods! Featuring a practical floor plan, this unit offers a generous living space, a private screened-in balcony, ample kitchen cabinetry, and an oversized in-suite storage room. Residents enjoy the convenience of an elevator and laundry facilities located on the same floor. Situated in an established neighbourhood, the property is just steps from public transit and within walking distance of Pollard Meadows School. Shopping, parks, recreation centres, healthcare facilities, and everyday essentials are all nearby, with quick access to Anthony Henday Drive for an easy commute. (id:67522)
